leaves.doc: sga33-steps, printed form (specialized to traits): SGA 7 I, Exp. IX, Cor. 3.3, p. 348 (semistable reduction: Def. 3.4, p. 349; locator from the 11-16 reading in the task brief): for an extension of DVRs O in O' (O' meet K = O, any K'/K, no henselian condition), Neron models N, N' with N semistable, the canonical u : N x_O O' -> N' (generic fibre the identification, bcDVR) induces an isomorphism N0 x_O O' = N'0 (an iso of open subschemes over N'). Replaces sga7_IX_3_3_SHpre: steps 1-3 (specialization; dictionary and Neron uniqueness; c = u . alpha with alpha an automorphism of N' fixing the unit) proved in SGA33Steps.shpre_of_cor33.
